svg.title: Journal: make the second face earn a distinct role
svg.desc: Only the headline font-family changes from Jost Regular to Source Serif 4 Display at weight 400 optical size 60. All other text remains Source Sans 3 Regular. Nominal headline size 40, words, baseline, anchor, body line breaks, other sizes and weights, spacing, photo bytes/crop, colors, paper and lighting remain fixed. The Source families are documented companions; the choice remains contextual. Fictional editorial page.

svg.text: BEFORE · Two relatively similar sans faces

g.text: FIELD / NOTES ON EVERYDAY OBJECTS
Objects for daily use
Collection notes · November
These cups are made for the everyday:
a morning coffee, a shared table,
the quiet pause between two jobs.
Each piece is shaped in small batches.
You can see the whole collection in
the studio, including bowls, plates
and a changing selection of glazes.
field.example/journal · 08
